description: Changes the secret that signs the webhooks (requires the token edm_…). The previous secret still signs for 24 h, so you can change it without a failure window. During the 24 h, the `webhook-signature` header has two `v1,…` parts: one with the new secret and one with the previous. The receiver only needs to accept any part that matches.
name: rotate_webhook_secret
title: Rotate the webhook secret
